mathematics.logical_review: The manuscript contains the broad-Q Koszul/index/seven-period proofs, analytic outer-rank theorem, computer-assisted mixed-rank theorem and Q=H=S corollary, domain structure and regularity criterion, finite Ore indexed-isomorphism criterion, and diagonal quotient. Independent AI-assisted readings checked the analytic reduction for the mixed ranks: the exact Koszul matrix, AS-dual index shift, cubic-syzygy bound, convergence, coefficientwise positivity, singularity identity and adjugate coefficient. A separate exact rational elimination reconstructed all 890 matrices directly from the Koszul Euler terms and independently reproduced the integer enumeration. Earlier retained claims have also received internal logical review. These checks are neither formal verification nor external peer review. The research-note obstruction for opposite one-sided R_5 relations was independently checked from the quotient relations and the equal-weight code words.
mathematics.scope: Over the standing algebraically closed characteristic-zero field: all Q have relation dimensions (1,2,2,1,0), the standard word-linear resolutions and standard two-variable Hilbert series. Mixed-rank forcing uses an exact finite integer lemma after analytic necessary conditions. Domainness, mixed-projection nondegeneracy, period one and noetherianity are not inferred for all Q. The domain Ore theorems and finite indexed-isomorphism criterion retain their stated scope; general n retains its existing hypotheses.

exact_computation.new_results: Computer-assisted proof of MIXED-RELATION-RANKS and TYPE-EXHAUST. Analytic AS/growth constraints reduce to an explicitly finite integer lemma; exhaustive exact computation proves that lemma. This does not certify AS-regularity of arbitrary relation data.
exact_computation.arithmetic: Integer Bareiss elimination with pivoting and exact-division checks; no floating point, random sampling or omitted cyclic representatives.

independent_audit.matrix_construction: Directly from all terms of the seven-row Koszul Euler polynomial, independently of the collapsed C_delta formula
independent_audit.arithmetic: Fraction-based rational Gaussian elimination; no call to the canonical Bareiss routine
